test_inputs.explanation: Values were taken from the agent's navigation: base_url from the visited host in the URLs; shipment_increment, order_increment, ship_to_name, total_qty_from and total_qty_to were encoded in the long filter parameter on Step 8 (decoded as increment_id=100000032, order_increment_id=100000199, shipping_name=Jane Doe, total_qty_from=1, total_qty_to=1); view_shipment_db_id comes from the View URL (/view/shipment_id/35/) seen in Steps 6 and 9. The massaction and export_format were not explicitly recorded in the log, so common working choices (PDF Packingslips and CSV) were provided to allow replay of mass-action and export flows.
